instruction: Using Terminal, inspect the current activity of the tmux session "tmux-shared-read-a4" and write the result in JSON format to "$HOME/Desktop/tmux_result_1_4.json". The key "session" should be set to "tmux-shared-read-a4", and the key "latest_output" should contain the most recent output from that tmux session.

command: tmux new-session -d -s "tmux-shared-read-a4" "printf '%s\\n' 'docs pipeline: waiting' 'last task: blog index rebuild' 'TMUX_SHARED_MARKER_1D'; tail -f /dev/null"

reference_command:
python3 - <<'PY' > "$HOME/Desktop/tmux_result_1_4.json"
import json
import subprocess
out = subprocess.check_output(['tmux', 'capture-pane', '-t', 'tmux-shared-read-a4', '-p'], text=True)
lines = [line for line in out.splitlines() if line.strip()]
latest_output = '\n'.join(lines[-20:])
print(json.dumps({'session': 'tmux-shared-read-a4', 'latest_output': latest_output}))
PY
